title: Descent of opens along an fpqc covering
statement: Let $\{g_i:T_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], and let $V\to S$ be etale. If opens $W_i\subset T_i\times_S V$ have equal pullbacks to $T_i\times_S T_j\times_S V$ for all $i,j$, then there is a unique open $W\subset V$ whose pullback to every $T_i\times_S V$ is $W_i$.
